title: blockchain-explorer
tagline: A website to view data about your account sort of like an explorer
description: A website to view data about your account sort of like an explorer like Etherscan but with limited features currently. The future plans include aggregating the data, being able to display the data in a presentable manner as well as showing the user a graph of how their investments are going. Made using next.js, convalent api, tableland, and nft port.
